null_rule: Missing numeric values remain null; incomplete required evidence prevents real-world acceptance. A failed exact calendar request is not zero market demand.

units.physical_leg: one aircraft movement on a dated origin-destination leg
units.service_rule: published endpoint/timetable rule; no assumption of nonstop or performed service
units.passenger_product: one endpoint journey with ordered leg IDs; counted once irrespective of transfers
units.roundtrip_product: outbound and return journeys for one customer; hotel nights use local stay dates
units.money: RUB/comparison-period; fare per one-way endpoint journey, after agreed sales deductions but before passenger expenses included separately
units.resource: UTC instants, elapsed minutes, tail position, occupied minutes; aircraft availability and crew legality separate

baselines.C14: Current competitor announced/dated product for passenger calendar. RW investment comparison is full proposed SVX-KVX-MRV-KVX-SVX versus preserving existing network; no confirmed donor or free base legs.
baselines.C01: Clock coordination experiment: identical directed legs, block durations, nominal seats and initial/final tail positions. Both are hypothetical programs. Incremental new-base/overnight/connection/reserve/retiming costs and changes to local sales are explicit UNKNOWN; unmatched real no-new-base operational baseline remains UNKNOWN.
baselines.C07: Published SVX-OMS-SVX pattern as a timing reference; four-leg SVX-OMS-KJA-OMS-SVX adds every OMS-KJA leg and turn. Reference is not labelled unprofitable donor. Keep/replace/remove actual flight requires donor records UNKNOWN.

required_tables: net realised fares and costs by accounting scope
common_gates: market and launch acceptance separately UNKNOWN

frozen_scenarios.label: ILLUSTRATIVE_ARITHMETIC_AND_RESOURCE_TESTS_NOT_FORECAST
frozen_scenarios.nominal_seats_origin: team stage18 assumptions nominal100; not actual RW payload
frozen_scenarios.turn_origin: author planning stress points, not approved station minimum
frozen_scenarios.connection_origin: author product window, not published MCT or interline protection
frozen_scenarios.window_origin: author elapsed-aircraft-window stress, not crew legal duty
frozen_scenarios.fare_origin: author round numbers for inversion only; no observed offer or paid fare
frozen_scenarios.expense_origin: author inversion points before acceptance; costs already netted from fare must not be charged twice
frozen_scenarios.gap_origin: same numerical stress points as team stage18 fixed-extra burden, reinterpreted explicitly as unknown total residual funding gap per comparison period; not inherited estimated hub/route cost

financial_equation: Delta contribution = sum_j(q_j*(net_fare_j-variable_journey_cost_j)) - residual_funding_gap. Gap includes ALL candidate legs, incremental fixed/base/positioning/switching/opportunity costs, donor avoidable contribution and retained-network cannibalization, net of other explicitly accounted contribution. Actual components UNKNOWN.
simple_inverse: For one symmetric return product with q paid one-way journeys in EACH direction, q_min=max(0,ceil(gap/(2*(fare-variable_cost)))); no finite solution if margin<=0 and gap>0. This is a sales threshold, not market OD.
capacity_rule: Each passenger product consumes one seat on every physical leg it uses; no capacity may be reused across local/transfer products. Nominal capacity is SCENARIO.
multiple_testing: Export every grid row and every failed attempt; no weights or scenarios tuned after results; new contract version required for changes.
donor_rule: Do not infer a real donor from a bad additional-flight scenario; compare keep/replace/remove with avoidable costs, timing and obligation records or NOT_EVALUATED.
